draft.title: Liveability
card: Liveability is how good a place is to live. It is judged by how well the place meets the everyday needs of the people who live there.
Common measures are housing, transport, safety, services, green space and the environment. Services include schools, health care and shops.
A place with affordable housing, reliable public transport, low crime and clean air is likely to be seen as more liveable.
Liveability is about daily life for residents. People may rate the same place differently, because they value different things, such as parks or short travel times.
draft.remember: Liveability is how well a place meets residents' daily needs across several measures.

a.q: Which of these is a measure of a city's liveability?
opts: How safe residents feel and how easily they reach services
How many people were born in the city last year
How much farmland lies beyond the edge of the city
How many tourists visit the city each year
a.why: Safety and access to services affect residents' daily lives, so they are measures of liveability. Tourist numbers describe visitors, not how well the place meets the needs of the people who live there.
a.clue: Think about what matters to people living there each day.

b.q: Dara moves to a suburb with cheap rent, low crime and a large park. The nearest train station is 40 minutes away and there is no clinic. Which statement best describes its liveability?
opts: Mixed, as some measures are strong and others are weak
High, because cheap rent is the main measure of liveability
Low, because one weak measure makes a suburb unliveable
Unknown, because liveability cannot be judged by measures
b.why: Housing, safety and green space look strong, while transport and services look weak. Liveability uses several measures together, so the result is mixed. It is wrong to say one measure alone decides it, in either direction.
b.clue: Sort the details into strong and weak measures.

a.best: How safe residents feel and how easily they reach services

b.best: Mixed, as some measures are strong and others are weak
